item.description: Yesterday the Scottish government announced the Budget for 2026-7. Below are some budget specifics relevant for our sector: ‘We will provide £20 million uplift to the culture budget in support of […]

item.title: Publishing Scotland attends National Year of Reading Launch in Scotland | Publishing Scotland
item.description: A note from our CEO, Sheila Pinder, upon attending the National Year of Reading Launch in Scotland at the National Library. Find out more about conversations had on the day and what Publishing Scotland will be doing.

item.title: Publishing Scotland signs new Publishing Inclusion Pledge | Publishing Scotland
item.description: We are proud to support the Publishing Inclusion Pledge 2026-28, a new initiative which recognises and celebrates that diverse perspectives strengthen the UK’s publishing sector.

item.title: Interview with Publishing Scotland CEO Sheila Pinder published in The Herald Scotland | Publishing Scotland
item.description: Today our CEO Sheila Pinder's interview with Dominic Ryan was published in The Herald Scotland. Sheila shares insights into the diverse structure of the industry, and the value of its perseverance in the face of funding struggles and AI-related copyright fears.

item.title: Longlist announced for 2026 Walter Scott Prize for Historical Fiction | Publishing Scotland
item.description: The Abbotsford Trust has announced the 12 title Longlist for the 2026 Walter Scott Prize for Historical Fiction.

item.title: Highland Book Prize 2025 Longlist Announced | Publishing Scotland
item.description: Yesterday the longlist for the Highland Book Prize 2025 has been announced by the Highland Society of London and Moniack Mhor, Scotland’s Creative Writing Centre.

item.title: BookSource Awarded Gold in Fair Payment Code | Publishing Scotland
item.description: BookSource has been awarded the highest level of recognition under the Fair Payment Code (FPC).

item.title: Canongate campaign wins a Publishers’ Publicity Circle Award | Publishing Scotland
item.description: This week the Publishers’ Publicity Circle (PPC) announced the winners of the 2025 PPC Awards.

item.title: Publishing Scotland’s new Mo Siewcharran Fund Supported Marketing Data and Events Trainee appointed | Publishing Scotland
item.description: We are delighted to announce that Chantelle Streete will be joining us on the18th of March for a six-month Marketing, Data and Events traineeship. This placement is enabled by Creative Access and 50% funded by the Mo Siewcharran Memorial Fund.

item.title: Publishing Scotland Reveals Eight International Publishing Fellows for 2026 | Publishing Scotland
item.description: At the London Book Fair this evening Publishing Scotland will announce eight new International Publishing Fellows for 2026.
